evidence: tools/life-expectancy-calculator.html:505-508: baseline = F ? 79.0 : 73.8; estimated = baseline + adjustments; yearsLeft = max(0, min(105, estimated) - age). Default answers are all 0 (never smoked, no alcohol, no exercise, BMI normal selected, health Fair selected, no diabetes, high school, single, below-average income), so node gives a 70-year-old man 3.8 years left and an 80-year-old man 0.0. SSA 2022 period life table (TR2025) gives 14.09 remaining years for a man of exactly 70. Lede line 229 says 'A research-based estimate'; line 325 says 'a simplified assumption built into the tool, not an official statistic'; meta/og/twitter/JSON-LD (lines 132, 148, 159, 176) say 'population baselines and research-adjusted factors'. Line 337 says adjustments are additive. No source is cited for any adjustment.
fix_correction: The direction is right. Three refinements. (1) Don't add birth-based lifestyle adjustments (smoking -10, diabetes -6) unscaled to remaining life expectancy at older ages: a 70-year-old smoker would get 4 years. Scale each adjustment by remaining LE at the current age divided by LE at birth, or by a published hazard ratio, and keep a floor so the result never reaches 0 for a living person. (2) Name the table you use on the page (SSA is US-only and the page is served in ja). (3) The meta description is generator-owned: change it in scripts/build-tools-seo.mjs (the SEO override at line 969, plus the desc and cardDesc at line 46), not only in tools/*.html, or the next build reverts it. The 'How the estimate is calculated' paragraph (tbff000f008, the 73.8/79.0 baseline) must change too.
translation_note: i18n/tools/en.json life-expectancy-calculator has 88 units, and ja has 88/88. Units that change: t69ba522453 (lede), t172ddacbaa (cap paragraph), tbff000f008 (baseline paragraph, which the agent missed), af17ed8cdd5 (one attribute unit shared by meta, og and twitter, because the text is identical), lf17ed8cdd5 (JSON-LD), plus 1-2 new source lines. That gives about 82/90 = 91%, which is above 90% but close. If the per-adjustment sources go into the 9 <li> units, ja drops to about 73/90 = 81% and /ja/tools/life-expectancy-calculator would unpublish. Put the sources in one new paragraph, or translate them in the same push. Only tools/ja is released; the other 17 locales are 100% translated but held.
notes: Result labels 'est. lifespan (yrs)' and 'life elapsed' in the inline script are hard-coded English (line 516/518).
